entries.zh: 收税；征收并收取租税（税款）
entries.en: to collect the rent/tax; to receive it (to collect tax)
entries.notes: R 栏对音（chǐm sūiⁿ）与 H「收税」、M「sīū sūẽ」不合，义依 H/M 及 L「cobran…recibirlo」（收+收下）定。

entries.zh: 解官；押解、解送贡赋税银的官员
entries.en: the official who escorts/delivers the tribute; tribute collector

entries.zh: 课官；征收船舶税课（船货税）的税吏
entries.en: the tax official who collects the duties levied on vessels (shipping dues)

entries.zh: 推官；征收王室税课（皇家税入）的税吏
entries.en: collector of the royal dues; a 推官 charged with royal revenue
entries.notes: H 作「推割」非成词，M「chûy cuã」与 R「chǐi cāo」并指「推官」，L 明言王室税课征收者。

entries.zh: 税课官；征收王室税课的税吏
entries.en: the tax-and-duty official; collector of the royal dues

entries.notes: H 第二字有 [疑:蟲/錢]，M 仅作「Tā̃ng」(銅)，L 为 Cobre，故铜与铜钱并陈。

entries.zh: 交趾；交趾支那（今越南中南部）

entries.notes: L 拼写残（paelber ≈ para beber），义据 H「椰瓢」及 M/R 对音定。
L「esconder la de coco」当为「escudilla de coco」之误读，与 H「椰碗」及 M/R 对音合。

entries.en: to covet; to be greedy for
entries.notes: R 栏「cop.」为未释缩写标记，不影响 貪（tām）本义判定。
H 字有 [疑:暍/渴]，M「Tōū̃」与二者音均不合，义依 L「codiciar, desear」定。

entries.en: to lust; to covet sensual pleasures
entries.notes: H「慈」与 M「yǒg」(欲)、R「yō」及 L（cosas de luxuria）皆不合，断为「欲/慾」之讹。

entries.en: to harbor (a desire) in the heart; to cherish secretly
entries.notes: L「guardando assi dicho」语义晦，取 懷（hoâi）本义「心怀、暗藏」为释。

entries.en: to long for; to be attached to, to covet
to be addicted to; to crave

entries.zh: 贪赃；官吏贪取公帑、收受贿赂
entries.en: to take bribes; (of a mandarin) to covet and plunder public property
